items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Yeah I got to play with Charlie Parker one time.

ctx.x: Anybody that you would have liked to take and played a couple of gigs with? Charlie Parker perhaps?

Charlie Parker of course. I got to play with Dizzy. Yeah I got to play with Charlie Parker one time. I was with a band, the Charlie Fisk band, and we had a few days off in Kansas City, and the tenor player knew this club that Charlie was sitting in, so we went out. And there he was playing. So we got up on the stand and the very first tune they played was “Cherokee,” which is very difficult. So Charlie played. And he never played long. He never played many choruses, he didn’t need to. So the guy next to me says,…
Yeah, that “Cherokee” is one tough tune. You ever play that tune on these kind of parties?
